betterbiplot: Better Looking Biplots in Base R

Source: R/betterbiplot-package.R
betterbiplot-package.Rd

Creates customisable biplots for Principal Component Analysis (PCA) using only base R graphics. Supports 'prcomp()', 'princomp()', 'vegan::rda()', 'survey::svyprcomp()', 'FactoMineR::PCA()', 'ade4::dudi.pca()', and 'psych::principal()' objects as well as custom score and loading matrices, with support for grouping by colour, symbol, and size, covariance and Hotelling-t ellipses, convex hulls, centroids, spider lines, circles of equilibrium contribution, label rotation, and selective legends.
